Built on Hard Work. Grounded in Integrity.

More Than Concrete. A Commitment to Doing Things Right.

Our Story

Every great project starts with a solid foundation. We believe the same principle applies to building a business.

Set Right Flatwork LLC was built around a straightforward belief: concrete work should be done with care, honesty, and attention to the details that matter.

In an industry where the finished result is often what gets noticed, we believe the real difference begins long before the concrete is poured. It starts with proper preparation, thoughtful planning, understanding the customer’s needs, and taking pride in every stage of the process.

Our name reflects that philosophy. ‘Set Right’ represents our commitment to approaching every project with the right mindset, the right preparation, and respect for the work being done.

Based in Louisville, Kentucky, Set Right Flatwork focuses on residential and commercial concrete flatwork, helping property owners create practical, attractive, and lasting outdoor and structural surfaces.

From driveways and patios to sidewalks, concrete slabs, and other flatwork projects, our approach remains consistent: understand the project, pay attention to the details, and work toward a result that serves its purpose.

We understand that a concrete project is more than another construction task. It can mean a more welcoming entrance to a home, a better place for family gatherings, a safer walkway, or an improved space for a growing business.

That is why we believe every project deserves consideration, regardless of its size.

We are proud to be part of the Louisville community and believe that local businesses should contribute something meaningful: dependable service, responsible work practices, and relationships built on trust.

At Set Right Flatwork, we are not interested in taking shortcuts or making promises simply to win a project. We believe in straightforward communication, realistic expectations, and treating every property with respect.

Our philosophy is simple:

PREPARE IT RIGHT.POUR IT RIGHT.FINISH IT RIGHT.

That is the standard behind the name Set Right Flatwork.

A Better Standard Starts With a Simple Idea.

Set Right Flatwork represents a practical vision of what a concrete contractor should stand for.

We believe customers deserve to understand what is being done on their property, why it matters, and what to expect throughout the project.

We want to make the concrete construction experience more straightforward, with an emphasis on communication, workmanship, and respect for every customer’s investment.

Our goal is to build a business recognized not only for the surfaces it helps create, but also for the way it approaches its work.

Our Mission

To provide dependable concrete flatwork solutions through careful preparation, quality-focused workmanship, honest communication, and respect for every property we work on.

We aim to create functional, attractive concrete surfaces that meet the needs of homeowners and businesses throughout the Louisville area.

Our Vision

To grow into a trusted name in Louisville’s concrete construction industry by maintaining consistent standards, building lasting customer relationships, and treating every project as an opportunity to demonstrate the value of doing things right.

We believe a strong reputation is built one project, one customer, and one commitment at a time.

Our Core Values

The standards behind every estimate, every pour, and every conversation.

  1. 01

    Quality Without Shortcuts

    We believe proper preparation and attention to detail are essential to successful concrete work. The process matters just as much as the finished surface.

  2. 02

    Honesty & Transparency

    Clear communication and realistic expectations should be part of every customer relationship. Customers deserve straightforward answers and understandable project estimates.

  3. 03

    Pride in Craftsmanship

    Concrete work requires planning, patience, and skill. We respect the process and recognize that the details contribute to the final result.

  4. 04

    Respect for Every Property

    Whether working on a residential driveway, backyard patio, or commercial property, we believe in maintaining an organized work area and treating each property responsibly.

  5. 05

    Reliability & Accountability

    We value keeping customers informed, respecting agreed project expectations, and taking responsibility for the work we undertake.

  6. 06

    Community Matters

    As a Louisville-area business, we recognize the importance of local relationships. We believe in contributing positively through responsible service, respectful work practices, and meaningful customer relationships.

Doing Good Work Goes Beyond the Job Site.

We believe responsible construction involves more than installing concrete.

Our approach emphasizes respect for neighboring properties and surrounding communities, responsible handling of construction materials, organized work areas, minimizing unnecessary waste where practical, and considering the surrounding landscape when planning projects.

We understand that every project becomes part of a larger neighborhood, and we believe that deserves consideration.

  • Respect for neighbors
  • Responsible material handling
  • Organized work areas
  • Practical waste reduction
  • Safe work practices
  • Consideration of drainage and surroundings
  • Positive local relationships

The Set Right Difference

  • Preparation

    A successful concrete project starts with understanding the site and preparing the foundation properly.

  • Precision

    Careful layout, placement, and finishing help create a surface designed for its intended use.

  • Communication

    Customers should know what to expect and understand the important stages of their project.

  • Pride

    We believe the quality of our work should reflect the values behind our name.

Let’s Build Something Solid.

Whether you are planning a new driveway, upgrading your outdoor living space, or improving a commercial property, Set Right Flatwork is ready to discuss your concrete project.

We believe the best projects begin with a conversation and a clear understanding of what needs to be done.
